LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_EnabledDesc: Run the off-map settlement sim (chronicle + morph + diplomacy). Turn off to disable everything.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_ChronicleDesc: Send letters when hear-rules pass. Soft consumers still receive events.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_MorphDesc: Prosperity drift, ownership flips, abandons, outposts, epithets.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_DiplomacyDesc: NPC factions drift through peace, tension, war, and rare alliances without involving you.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_FalloutDesc: After severe wars you hear about, refugees (and optional warbands) may reach your colony.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_TradeBlackoutDesc: Factions locked in intense war rarely send trade caravans until the fighting cools.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_WarSitesDesc: After decisive NPC battles, spawn short-lived battlefield / refugee-camp pins on the world map (not Nemesis hunt sites).
LanguageData.LivingWorld_Settings_WarbandDesc: Rare hostile or tense warbands chasing a war you heard about. Off by default — keep cautious.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Skirmish: {0} and {1} clashed near {2}. The rim barely noticed — unless you were listening.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_DecisiveVictory: {0} crushed {1} in fighting around {2}. The balance of power on the rim just shifted.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_FamineRumor: Word from {2}: {0} is short on food. Travelers speak of empty stores and thin herds.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Founding: {0} founded {2}. Another pin on the world map that was not there yesterday.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Collapse: {2} of {0} has gone quiet. Refugees may follow — or silence.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Alliance: {0} and {1} have sworn common cause. Expect fewer knives between them — for now.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Betrayal: {0} turned on {1}. Old promises burned with the treaty.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_OwnershipFlip: {0} seized {2} from {1}. The banners on the walls have changed.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_ProsperityRise: {2} ({0}) is doing well — fuller markets, louder streets.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_ProsperityFall: {2} ({0}) is struggling. Trade thins; people look elsewhere.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_OutpostFounded: {0} raised a new outpost at {2}, extending their reach.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_SettlementAbandon: {0} abandoned {2}. The site is empty on the world map.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_Epithet: {2} of {0} has earned a new nickname among travelers.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_WhitePeace: {0} and {1} have stopped open fighting near {2}. Tension remains.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_RefugeeFlight: Survivors from {0} fled fighting with {1} around {2}. A ragged group has reached your borders seeking safety.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_TradeBlackout: War between {0} and {1} has choked caravans near {2}. Expect fewer traders from the embattled side.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_LetterText_WarbandPass: A warband of {0} is hunting remnants of {1} from the fighting near {2}. They are passing through your region.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_WarSite_BattlefieldInspect: Recent battlefield debris from an off-map war.
LanguageData.LivingWorld_WarSite_RefugeeCampInspect: A temporary refugee camp spawned by distant fighting.
